Author: Alok Kumar Verma

 In The High Court Of Uttarakhand
 At Nainital
 (Before the National Lok Adalat)
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Alok Kumar Verma
 11Th May, 2024

 Versus

 At Nainital

sentences.text: Counsel for the Applicant : Mr. Mohd. Azim, Advocate.

Counsel for the State : Ms. Meenakshi Sharma,
 Brief Holder.

Counsel for the Respondent : Mr. Mohd. Umar,
No.2 Advocate.
Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.

The present Application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 has been filed to quash the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.342 of 2021, "State vs. Mohd. Najim", pending before the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate/ Additional Civil Judge, Khatima, District Udham Singh Nagar under Sections 498A, 323, 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
2.

sentences.text: Applicant - Mohd. Najim is identified by Mr. Mohd. Azim, Advocate.

Respondent no.2 - Smt.
Afsana is identified by Mr. Mohd. Umar, Advocate.
4. Both the parties have submitted that a Compounding Application and affidavits, filed by the parties, are on record.
A Compromise Application has been filed by the parties today before the National Lok Adalat.
5. Both, the applicant and the respondent no.2 submitted that there were matrimonial disputes between them and they have resolved their disputes.
They have requested to quash the entire proceedings of the said Criminal Case.
6. Learned counsel for the State has submitted that there were matrimonial disputes between the parties and they have resolved their disputes.
Therefore, the State has no objection to the Compounding Application.
7. The Compromise Application is verified.

8. Keeping in view the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the view that ends of justice would be met, if the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.342 of 2021, "State vs. Mohd. Najim", pending before the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate/ Additional Civil Judge, Khatima, District Udham Singh Nagar, are quashed.

entities.label: COURT
